journey.name: Search - Post Filters
journey.description: Verifies the filter chip row on the Posts results: quick chips, the filters sheet, a date preset, Reset, and that a new search starts without filters. Works on any window width. Uses the offline bench build, where the fake search returns the same posts for any query and the Media filter visibly narrows the list.

actions.action: Tap the Search tab on the main navigation
Tap the search bar
Type a search query into the search field
Submit the search
Verify that the Posts tab shows a row of filter chips: a filters control, Sort, Following, Media, Video, Language and Date
Verify that the Posts, People, Feeds and Packs tabs are shown
Record the number of posts visible in the results list
Tap the Media chip
Verify that the list of results changed to fewer posts and that the Media chip is selected
Tap the filters control, the first chip in the row
Verify that the filters sheet is shown
Choose "Hide replies" in the filters sheet
Close the filters sheet
Verify that the filters control shows the number 2
Tap the Date chip
Choose one of the date presets from the menu
Verify that the Date chip now shows the name of the chosen preset
Tap the filters control
Tap Reset in the filters sheet
Close the filters sheet
Verify that no filter chip is selected and that the filters control shows no number
Clear the search field
Type a different search query into the search field
Submit the search
Verify that the Posts tab shows the filter chip row with no chip selected and the filters control shows no number
